description: Cluster Analysis Chart Convergent Business Technologies · Free · Microsoft Certified A scatter plot shows you where points sit; it does not tell you which points belong together. The Cluster Analysis Chart groups your data by similarity and draws the result, so natural segments, and the outliers that sit outside them, become visible without leaving your report. K-Means, DBSCAN, and Hierarchical clustering all run in the browser in pure TypeScript. No R, no Python, no external service, and no data leaves Power BI. Clusters recompute live as filters change, and every feature is free. Key Capabilities Three Algorithms - K-Means with automatic cluster-count selection by elbow or silhouette, DBSCAN for density-based shapes, and Hierarchical with four linkage methods Dendrogram View - Switch Hierarchical clustering to a dendrogram to see the full merge tree and the height your clusters were cut at Cluster Shape - Centroids, convex hulls, and confidence ellipses, with jitter to separate overlapping points and rename-able clusters Outlier Detection - DBSCAN noise points are identified and drawn separately, styled hollow grey or in a colour of your choice Summary Table - Per-cluster averages for every variable, shaded against the population average so differences read at a glance Small Multiples & Interactivity - Trellis grid with axis coupling, cross-filtering, drill-down,…
